name: Fiend
source:
"Fiend" is a short story about unfolding mysterious happenings in an isolated town.
You are not alone. 
Join the fox in uncovering the mystery that is, "Fiend".

[From [url=https://ramsker.itch.io/fiend]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《恶魔》是一个关于在一个偏僻小镇上发生的神秘事件的短篇故事。
你并不孤单。
与狐狸一起揭开“恶魔”之谜。

[来自[url=https://ramsker.itch.io/fiend]Itch.io[/url]]
